---
title: "Schedule"
---

Eight weeks, one session every **Saturday**, from **31 October to 19 December 2026**: eight sessions of **3 hours** (with a 15-minute break), Session *n* in Week *n*. Weeks 1–4 build understanding and design skills; Weeks 5–8 analyse the simulated **FLUID-ICU** dataset through live instructor demos and write it up as a manuscript. The whole course is **Level 1** ([course levels](levels.qmd)).

| Week | Session | Day | Theme | Your group builds |
|:---:|:--------|:--------|:----------|:------------------------------------|
| 1 | [Session 1](session1.qmd) | Saturday 31/10/2026 | **Ask** | Proposal: topic, PICO, question, aims |
| 2 | [Session 2](session2.qmd) | Saturday 07/11/2026 | **Find & read** | Proposal: search, 5 references, problem statement, title |
| 3 | [Session 3](session3.qmd) | Saturday 14/11/2026 | **Design** | Proposal: design, setting, population |
| 4 | [Session 4](session4.qmd) | Saturday 21/11/2026 | **Bias & effect** | Proposal: exposure, outcomes, bias plan |
| 5 | [Session 5](session5.qmd) | Saturday 28/11/2026 | **Data** | Proposal: variables, CRF, data plan · Manuscript: Table 1 understood |
| 6 | [Session 6](session6.qmd) | Saturday 05/12/2026 | **Analyse** | Proposal: sample size, analysis plan · Manuscript: results interpreted |
| 7 | [Session 7](session7.qmd) | Saturday 12/12/2026 | **Protect & write** | Proposal: ethics, feasibility, publication plan · Manuscript: Methods + Results |
| 8 | [Session 8](session8.qmd) | Saturday 19/12/2026 | **Publish** | Manuscript: complete draft · Proposal presented |

## Session 1 · Ask: from clinical problem to research question

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 20 | Welcome, introductions, course map, groups and roles, ground rules |
| 0:20 | 08:20 | 15 | Pre-course quiz |
| 0:35 | 08:35 | 35 | **1.1 Why research?** Anecdote vs evidence, evidence pyramid, research cycle, types of research, research vs audit vs QI, the journey from idea to publication |
| 1:10 | 09:10 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 09:25 | 40 | **1.2 From problem to question:** where questions come from, PICO(T) with several worked examples, descriptive vs analytical questions, vague vs answerable, FINER (pair task) |
| 2:05 | 10:05 | 20 | **1.3 Aims, objectives, hypotheses** (null vs alternative) + quick exercise |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 1:** choose topic, PICO, research question, FINER check, aim & objectives |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up, homework |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Session 3 · Design: choosing the right study

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 45 | **3.1 Study designs in pictures:** descriptive vs analytical, case report/series, cross-sectional, case-control, cohort, RCT, systematic review/meta-analysis, evidence pyramid, decision tree, strengths & weaknesses, what each design can claim |
| 0:55 | 08:55 | 15 | Exercise: Name that design |

| 2:00 | 10:00 | 20 | Exercise: choose the design for 5 questions (incl. your own) |
| 2:20 | 10:20 | 35 | **Proposal builder 3:** design + justification, setting, population (inclusion/exclusion) |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

## Session 4 · Bias & effect: can we trust it, how big is it?

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 40 | **4.1 Bias, confounding and causation:** random error vs bias, selection, information, confounding (by indication), interaction, validity, Bradford Hill, reverse causation, how designs fight bias; spot-the-bias quiz |
| 0:50 | 08:50 | 30 | **4.2 Measuring disease and association:** prevalence vs incidence, risk, 2×2, RR / OR / RD / NNT, OR vs RR; **live 2×2 calculator demo** |
| 1:20 | 09:20 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:35 | 09:35 | 20 | Exercise: two 2×2 calculations |
| 1:55 | 09:55 | 30 | **4.3 Beyond single studies:** diagnostic accuracy (sens/spec, PPV & prevalence, ROC), systematic reviews & forest plots, heterogeneity, risk-of-bias tools, "are the conclusions supported?" (pair task) |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 4:** exposure & comparator, outcomes, main biases & mitigation |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

[Open Session 4](session4.qmd)
:::

## Session 5 · Data: collect it well, describe it honestly

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 35 | **5.1 Good data by design:** variable types, CRF principles, data dictionary, validation, data management (EDC, double entry, audit trail, backups), preventing missing data |
| 0:45 | 08:45 | 25 | **5.2 [DS] Meet the course dataset:** the FLUID-ICU study, its data dictionary, raw vs clean data, the data-quality problems found, **live R demo of cleaning** and the cleaning log; group questions assigned |
| 1:10 | 09:10 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 09:25 | 35 | **5.3 Describing and showing data:** mean/median, SD/IQR, shapes, which graph for which data, good vs bad figures, publication-quality tables, Table 1 |
| 2:00 | 10:00 | 25 | **5.4 [DS] Describe the course dataset:** live demo of Table 1 and figures; each group reads its results pack's Table 1 and figures (worksheet) |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 5:** variables table, mini-CRF, data dictionary rows, data-management plan |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

## Session 6 · Analyse: from sample to answer

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 40 | **6.1 From sample to population:** CI, p-values & misinterpretations, type I/II errors, power, sample size (**live demo**), choosing a test, paired vs unpaired, multiple comparisons |
| 0:50 | 08:50 | 20 | **6.2 [DS] Compare groups in the course dataset:** live demo (t-test / Mann–Whitney / chi-square); groups interpret their outputs |
| 1:10 | 09:10 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 09:25 | 35 | **6.3 Relationships and models:** correlation, linear and logistic regression, adjustment, interaction, overfitting, Kaplan–Meier & Cox, prediction/ML; reading regression tables & forest plots |
| 2:00 | 10:00 | 25 | **6.4 [DS] Model the course dataset:** crude vs adjusted OR (confounding by indication made visible), Kaplan–Meier + Cox HR, complete-case vs multiple imputation; the SAP that was written before the analysis |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 6:** sample size, analysis plan, missing-data plan |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |
